description: Add a public or private comment to a Zendesk ticket, optionally changing its assignee. Comments are public by default.

inputSchema.description: Request model for replying to a Zendesk ticket.

assignee_id.description: The ID of the agent to assign the ticket to
assignee_id.human_parameter_description: The ID of the agent you want to assign this ticket to. Leave empty to keep the current assignment.
assignee_id.title: Assignee Id

body.description: Comment content Must contain only the final reply text — do not include draft reasoning or mixed content.
body.human_parameter_description: What you want to say in the reply. This text will be added as a comment on the ticket.
body.title: Body

public.description: Whether the comment is public or internal Public comments are customer-facing and trigger email notifications to the requester; set to false for internal agent notes to prevent unintended customer visibility.
public.human_parameter_description: Choose whether your comment is visible to the requester. Turn this on for customer-facing replies, or off for internal notes.
public.title: Public

ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket to reply to. Note: Closed tickets cannot be updated.
ticket_id.human_parameter_description: The ID number of the ticket you want to reply to. Use the ID from Zendesk so your comment is added to the correct ticket. Note: You cannot reply to closed tickets.
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id
